title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) New Trailer and Key Visual Revealed
content: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) sequel anime revealed a new trailer and key visual ahead of its October 2 premiere date. The anime previously revealed the voice cast for the founding members of Black Dragon , as well as South Terano. The anime will stream exclusively on Disney+ worldwide.
author: Anime Corner

title: New Rokudenashi Blues Manga Delayed to Winter, Gets New Artist
content: This year's 18th issue of Shueisha 's Grand Jump magazine announced on August 19 that the launch of the upcoming Rokudenashi Blues Gaiden: Onikazura manga based on Masanori Morita 's Rokudenashi Blues manga is delayed from summer to winter and will now feature art by Yuki Yoshimoto .
author: ANN

title: Umayuru Full Gate! Umamusume’s Next ONA Premieres in September
content: Umayuru Full Gate! will be the next Umamusume: Pretty Derby anime. The short-form (three-minute) ONA will debut on the franchise’s YouTube channel this September. Cygames has released a visual for the upcoming anime and listed AtoriE as the studio.
author: Anime Corner

title: Taejun Pak Launches New Inked Comic
content: Webtoon artist Taejun Pak and his company The Grimm Entertainment have launched a new horizontal-scrolling comic in Japanese titled Inked on Kakao's Piccoma platform on August 16. The work is Pak's first horizontal-scrolling work.
author: ANN

title: Red River Anime Casts Sōma Saitō, Shun Horie

title: 'Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori' Announces Additional Cast Pair, Second Cour for Fall 2026
content: The official website of the Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ( Red River ) television anime revealed two additional cast members on Monday. The anime series adapting Chie Shinohara 's adventure fantasy manga is currently airing with a second cour scheduled to begin on September 29 at 1:35 a.m.

title: One Piece May Have Just Confirmed the Elbaph Arc Is Ending Very Soon
content: The One Piece manga continues its development despite having more breaks recently than ever. The manga is currently featuring an epic battle with Imu, the King of the World, who intends to bring Elbaph to its knees and is currently engaged in a battle against the warriors of Elbaph, with Luffy also joining the fight.
author: ComicBook

title: Crossed Hearts Launches Studio Hearts Imprint, New Licenses
content: California-based global English publisher Crossed Hearts announced on Sunday at the Anime NYC convention that it is launching an in-house imprint Studio Hearts and presenting several new licenses. Studio Hearts will launch with three original titles: Doomsday Requiem With You , Chiaroscuro , and Soul Guiders.
author: ANN

title: Yūki Kodama's Agent Jupiter Manga Ends
content: Comic Days published the final chapter of Yūki Kodama 's Agent Jupiter manga on August 20. The story follows the powerful agent Jupiter, who retires in the parallel world A after completing his quest of revenge for his sister in parallel world B.
author: ANN
